comments: Originally placed from this level and a 1698 level by 1996SpZZ, but 2004Ku13 do not confirm this latter level. Also, peak contains a contribution from a {+153}Gd impurity.
For the doublet, I|g=5.1~{I2}. Evaluator deduced split in intensity from I|g(533)/I|g(845)=0.012~{I4} from {+154}Gd Adopted |g radiations.
1996SpZZ report I|g=30.9~{I15} for the composite peak
From branching in {+154}Gd Adopted Levels, Gammas, I|g=9.3~{I12} is expected, so |g is probably a doublet.
Doubly placed by 1996SpZZ, but the level (1861.55) associated with the other placement has been shown (by 2004Ku13 in {+154}Eu |b{+-} decay) not to exist.
